message.content:
This is a protocol measurement. Follow these steps exactly and keep every reply to one short line.
1. Start ONE subagent with the Agent tool, subagent_type general-purpose, run_in_background true, description "INTERIM-CHILD".
   Give it this prompt: "Do exactly two things, then stop. (a) Start the Bash command `sleep 45 && echo child-done` with run_in_background true. (b) Start the Monitor tool on the command `sleep 15; echo tick` (load it with ToolSearch first if needed). Do not wait for either, and use no other wait tool. End your turn right away with the single line: INTERIM-WAITING. When you are woken later and both are done, reply with the single line: INTERIM-FINISHED. If woken while something still runs, end your turn with: INTERIM-WAITING."
2. After starting the subagent, end your turn at once with the line: started.
3. Whenever you are woken by a task notification, reply with one line naming the status, and do nothing else.
